headline: Q2FY27 Update

highlights: Positives: • Consolidated revenue grew 11.6% yoy to Rs3560 cr (in line). • Domestic volume /value grew 5.5%/10.7% (3.7%/7.5% 2-yr CAGR), as HPC (11%) and F&B (17.4%) growth. • Hair care (high-teen), digestives and OTC & Ethicals (mid-teens), digestives (strong DD) and home care (DD) led growth. • International grew 20% yoy in INR terms.
